title: Must & Can't Help: ざるを得ない, よりほかない, ねばならない, ないではいられない, てはいられない, ずに済む
description: Having no choice, formal 'must', not being able to stop yourself, not being able to afford to keep doing something, and getting away without doing it.

points.title: 〜ざるを得ない: have no choice but to
points.summary: ない-stem + ざるを得ない = forced by circumstances to do something you'd rather not. する → せざるを得ない.
points.body:
- 会社の命令なので、行か**ざるを得ない**.
- 雨で、中止**せざるを得ない**.

Formation: ない-form minus ない + ざる: 行かない → 行か**ざる**; **する → せざる**; 来る → こざる.
Nuance: reluctant obligation — stronger and more formal than しかない.
examples: {会社|かいしゃ}の{命令|めいれい}なので、{行|い}かざるを{得|え}ない。
It's a company order, so I have no choice but to go.

points.title: 〜よりほかない: there's nothing to do but
points.summary: Dictionary form + よりほかない(ほかはない) = the only option is. Similar to しかない, more formal.
points.body:
- 誰も手伝ってくれないので、自分でやる**よりほかない**.

Variants: よりほかはない, ほかない, よりしかたがない.
examples: {誰|だれ}も{手伝|てつだ}ってくれないので、{自分|じぶん}でやるよりほかない。
Nobody will help, so I have no choice but to do it myself.

points.title: 〜ねばならない: must (formal / written)
points.summary: ない-stem + ねばならない = なければならない in formal or written style. する → せねばならない.
points.body:
- 明日までに終わらせ**ねばならない**.
- もっと努力**せねばならない**.

Spoken short form: 〜ねば (行かねば！).
examples: {明日|あした}までに{終|お}わらせねばならない。
It must be finished by tomorrow.

points.title: 〜ないではいられない: can't help (doing)
points.summary: ない-form + ではいられない = can't stop yourself. Same as ずにはいられない (more colloquial).
points.body:
- その話を聞いて、笑わ**ないではいられなかった**.

Used for emotions/reactions you can't suppress.
examples: その{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いて、{笑|わら}わないではいられなかった。
Hearing that story, I couldn't help laughing.

points.title: 〜てはいられない: can't afford to (keep doing)
points.summary: て-form + はいられない = the situation doesn't allow you to keep doing this.
points.body:
- 試験まであと1週間だ。遊んで**はいられない**.
- ゆっくりして**はいられない** (no time to relax).
examples: {試験|しけん}まであと1{週間|しゅうかん}だ。{遊|あそ}んではいられない。
The exam is a week away — I can't afford to fool around.

points.title: 〜てばかりはいられない: can't just keep doing
points.summary: て-form + ばかりはいられない = you can't go on only doing this forever.
points.body: - いつまでも泣いて**ばかりはいられない** (I can't just keep crying).
examples: いつまでも{泣|な}いてばかりはいられない。
I can't just keep crying forever.

points.title: 〜ずに済む: get by without (having to) do
points.summary: ない-stem + ずに済む = luckily, you don't have to do something. Also 〜ないで済む / 〜なくて済む.
points.body:
- 友達が送ってくれたので、タクシーに乗ら**ずに済んだ**.

済む (すむ) = to be settled/finished. Don't confuse with 住む (to live)!
examples: {友達|ともだち}が{車|くるま}で{送|おく}ってくれたので、タクシーに{乗|の}らずに{済|す}んだ。
My friend drove me, so I didn't have to take a taxi.

questions.prompt: {会社|かいしゃ}の{命令|めいれい}なので、{行|い}か（　）。
notes: The pattern is negative: 得ない.
The particle is を, not に.
ずを isn't the form — it's ざる.
questions.translation: It's a company order, so I have no choice but to go.

questions.prompt: {台風|たいふう}のため、{試合|しあい}は{中止|ちゅうし}（　）ざるを{得|え}ない。
notes: すざる isn't a form.
しざる isn't a form.
さざる isn't a form.
questions.translation: Because of the typhoon, the match has to be cancelled.

questions.prompt: {誰|だれ}も{手伝|てつだ}ってくれないので、{自分|じぶん}でやる（　）。
notes: よりほかに can't end the sentence.
The order is wrong: よりほか.
The pattern is negative: ない.
questions.translation: Nobody will help, so I have no choice but to do it myself.

questions.prompt: What does 「{待|ま}つよりほかない」 mean?
options: There's nothing to do but wait.
questions.explanation: よりほかない = **no choice but**.
notes: That would be 待ちたくない.
より here isn't a comparison.
ほか here means 'other option', not 'other place'.

questions.prompt: {明日|あした}までにこの{仕事|しごと}を{終|お}わらせ（　）。
notes: いけるない isn't a form.
ならない is required.
ないば isn't a form.
questions.translation: This work must be finished by tomorrow.

questions.prompt: {目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}するためには、もっと{努力|どりょく}（　）ねばならない。
notes: さねば isn't a form.
すねば isn't a form.
しねば isn't a form.
questions.translation: To reach the goal, we must work harder.

questions.prompt: その{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いて、{笑|わら}わ（　）いられなかった。
questions.explanation: Can't help: **ないではいられない**.
notes: ずでは isn't a form (ずには would be).
なくてはいられない isn't the pattern.
は is needed: ないでは.
questions.translation: Hearing that story, I couldn't help laughing.

questions.prompt: {試験|しけん}まであと1{週間|しゅうかん}だ。{遊|あそ}んで（　）。
questions.explanation: Can't afford to: **てはいられない**.
notes: いらない = 'not needed'.
が isn't used in this pattern.
The pattern is negative.
questions.translation: The exam is a week away — I can't afford to fool around.

questions.explanation: Can't just keep: **てばかりはいられない**.
notes: The pattern is negative.
が isn't used here.
ばかりはいる isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: I can't just keep crying forever.

questions.prompt: {友達|ともだち}が{車|くるま}で{送|おく}ってくれたので、タクシーに{乗|の}ら（　）。
questions.explanation: Got by without: **ずに済んだ** (済む).
notes: ないに isn't a form (ないで済んだ would be).
ずで isn't a form.
住む = 'to live' — wrong kanji/verb.
questions.translation: My friend drove me, so I didn't have to take a taxi.

questions.prompt: {困|こま}っている{人|ひと}を{見|み}ると、{助|たす}け（　）。
questions.explanation: Can't help: **ないではいられない**.
notes: なくてはいられない isn't the pattern.
は is needed: ないでは.
The pattern is negative: いられない.
questions.translation: When I see someone in trouble, I can't help but help.

questions.prompt: {時間|じかん}がないので、ゆっくり{食|た}べて（　）。
questions.explanation: Can't afford to: **てはいられない**.
notes: はいる isn't the pattern.
もいられる = 'can also stay' — positive.
が isn't used here.
questions.translation: There's no time, so I can't sit around eating slowly.

questions.prompt: もう{大人|おとな}なのだから、{親|おや}に{頼|たよ}って（　）。
questions.explanation: Can't just keep: **てばかりはいられない**.
notes: が isn't used here.
ばかりはいる isn't the pattern.
The pattern is negative.
questions.translation: You're an adult now, so you can't keep relying on your parents.

questions.prompt: {会社|かいしゃ}の{近|ちか}くに{住|す}んでいるので、{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}ら（　）。
notes: 住む = 'to live' — wrong verb.
ずと isn't the pattern.
ずを isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: I live near the office, so I don't have to take the train.
